title: WhatsApp
html:
A global messaging platform with 2B users, 100B+ messages/day. Core challenges: message delivery guarantees, online presence, E2E encryption.

Requirements

Functional

1:1 and group messaging · Media sharing (photos, video, audio) · Message delivery receipts (sent/delivered/read) · Online presence · End-to-end encryption

Non-Functional

2B users · 100B msgs/day ≈ 1.2M msg/sec · Low latency (<500ms delivery) · High availability · Messages must not be lost

WebSockets for Real-Time

WhatsApp maintains a persistent WebSocket connection per user. This enables bidirectional, low-latency messaging without polling. When a user is offline, messages are queued in Cassandra and delivered when they reconnect. Each WebSocket server handles ~1M concurrent connections.
Delivery Receipts: Message server sends ACK to sender (✓ sent). When recipient's device receives it (✓✓ delivered). When recipient opens it (✓✓ blue = read). All receipts are separate messages flowing back through the same WebSocket infrastructure.
